aiMetadata.description: Send an outbound SMS text message to a phone number through the Bird (MessageBird) Channels API, using the workspace and channel configured in the connection. Choose this to deliver a text message to a single recipient; the recipient must be an E.164 phone number including country code. Optionally schedule it for a future UTC timestamp instead of sending immediately. Not idempotent — each call sends (or schedules) a new message.

listMessages.name: listMessages
listMessages.description: Lists an Messages via Bird Channels API

status.description: The status of the messages to filter by (select "All" for all statuses)

startAt.description: The start date and time (in UTC) to filter messages

endAt.description: The end date and time (in UTC) to filter messages, should not exceed 7 days from start date

pageToken.description: Token for pagination to fetch next set of results after 1000 messages

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve messages for the configured Bird (MessageBird) channel within a required UTC start/end time window (the span must not exceed 7 days). Choose this to read recent message history or to look up message status. Set status to "all" to return messages of every status, or pick a specific status (pending, sent, delivered, failed, etc.) to filter to matching messages only; supports a page token for paging past 1000 results. Read-only and idempotent.
